tasks.title: Upgrade detects diverged doc contracts and reports them truthfully
tasks.objective: cmd_upgrade collects replaced + diverged doc contracts (a diverged contract is a regular non-symlink file whose bytes differ from the new template); the completion report names the replaced contracts, qualifies the 'Untouched (project-owned)' dirs, and warns on divergence pointing the operator at git diff. No backup file is written. A regression test covers edited-vs-identical contracts and asserts no .orig appears.
acceptance_criteria: The upgrade report names each replaced doc-contract destination path and no longer implies a directory whose contract file was overwritten is fully untouched
When a client's doc-contract file differs from the new template, the upgrade names it and warns pointing at git diff; no backup files are created
Regression test: an edited doc-contract README is named replaced and warned, an identical one is not warned, and no .orig files appear

required_tests.command: uvx --with pytest --with psutil python3 -m pytest {path}::{id} -q -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml={report}

tasks.reviewer_focus: The new read follows symlinks: confirm the is_file() and not is_symlink() guard precedes read_bytes() (repository-escape recurring x3, decision 0028); confirm no write/backup/.orig path is added (copy path unchanged); confirm the report no longer lists a replaced contract's directory as unqualified 'Untouched (project-owned)'.
